commands.name: calc

operand.help: Read the first structure of an XYZ file in angstroms.
operand.name: FILE.xyz

options.help: Calculate energy (default), gradient, hessian or orbitals.
Use gfn2 (default), gfnff or gxtb.
Calculate energy; accepted for compatibility.
Include the Cartesian energy gradient in Eh/bohr.
Include Mayer–Wiberg bond orders.
Set the molecular charge.
Set the number of unpaired electrons. The default comes from the electron count.
Use axtb (default) or xtb-6.8 (xtb 6.8 compatible) conventions.
Use the ALPB solvent model; cannot be combined with --gbsa.
Use the GBSA solvent model; cannot be combined with --alpb.
Use gfn2 for g-xTB solvent calculations.
Set the electronic temperature in kelvin (GFN2-xTB 300, g-xTB 0 by default).
Set a positive SCF accuracy multiplier (default 1).
Set the SCF iteration limit (default 250).
Retry an unconverged SCF at K kelvin and optionally N iterations; repeat for a ladder.
Use 1 to 64 worker threads.

commands.summary: Print an xTB calculation as one JSON line
commands.usage: reshiki --cli calc [--task energy|gradient|hessian|orbitals] [--method gfn2|gfnff|gxtb] [--charge N] [--uhf N] [--conventions axtb|xtb-6.8] [--alpb NAME | --gbsa NAME] [--solvent-correction gfn2] [--etemp K] [--accuracy X] [--max-iter N] [--scf-retry K[:N]]... [--threads N] [--gradient] [--wbo] FILE.xyz
